manifest.body:
# Suppressed Package Install

Run `scripts/install.sh` during setup.

findings.title: Install command without matching lockfile
findings.message: The skill runs a npm install command without matching lockfile evidence, so dependency resolution may change between audits.
findings.rationale: Package installation without a matching lockfile can resolve different dependency graphs over time and weakens reproducible offline review.
findings.remediation: Commit the package manager lockfile for the install command, switch to a lockfile-backed install mode, or remove package installation from the skill workflow.
findings.suppression: Suppress `SUPPLY003` only for a reviewed install path whose dependency set is pinned or controlled by another documented local mechanism.

findings.title: Unpinned package dependency
findings.message: The package dependency `npm:left-pad` is not pinned to an exact version, so future installs may resolve different code.
findings.rationale: Unpinned package versions can change without a skill package change, making audits less reproducible and increasing supply-chain risk.
findings.remediation: Use exact package versions and commit the relevant lockfile when the package manager supports one.
findings.suppression: Suppress `SUPPLY004` only when a reviewed local policy intentionally allows version ranges and documents the update and review process.

finding.title: Package install without lockfile
finding.message: The artifact runs a JavaScript package install without nearby lockfile or exact version pinning evidence. This can make installs resolve different packages over time and increases reproducibility and supply-chain risk.
finding.rationale: Package installs without a lockfile or equivalent pinning can resolve different dependency versions across machines and over time.
finding.remediation: Use lockfile-backed install commands, root-level or same-subtree ecosystem lockfiles, or complete exact package pins. The initial policy treats npm/pnpm/yarn/bun, pip, cargo, gem, and system package installs without those offline-verifiable signals as `SEC009`.
finding.suppression: Suppress `SEC009` only when another reviewed, offline-verifiable mechanism pins the package set and preserves reproducible installation behavior.

suppression.reason: Package install command is pinned by an external reviewed process for this fixture.
